name: Gate 5A - Map one sanitized recovery result to review fields

nodes.name: Read Copied Sanitized Recovery Result
nodes.notes: Reads only the operator-copied sanitized Gate 4 recovery result staging file inside the n8n container. /home/node/.n8n-files is the n8n-approved file-access location. The operator copies the file in manually with docker compose cp; the workflow never contacts the AutoCount host and never modifies the file.

nodes.name: Validate Copied Sanitized Result Strictly
nodes.notes: Fail-closed: accepts exactly one nonblank JSON object matching the exact durable Gate 4 result contract with canonical Gate 4A identity shape, dry_run_only true, final_write_automation false, and a recomputed review state. Throws on anything else without echoing values.

nodes.name: Read One Approved Source Row
nodes.notes: Operator must select the real UAT spreadsheet, source tab, and Google credential in n8n UI. After binding, verify the Gate5AApprovedForMapping = YES filter is still present; add it manually if the import dropped it. Exactly one row may match. At typeVersion 4.7 the filter returns all matches by default so the downstream guard can require exactly one.

nodes.name: Verify Identity And Decide Mapping
nodes.notes: Rebuilds the canonical Gate 4A queue identity from the one approved source row (raw values in memory only, never output) and requires the sanitized result to match every shared safe identity field; a row number alone is never enough. Requires the controlled review columns to exist, requires a blank pre-mapping row or an exact prior application (already_applied), and refuses conflicts.

nodes.name: Apply Only Fresh Mapping
nodes.notes: True: fresh blank row, apply the controlled review/status update once. False: exact rerun (already_applied), skip the update entirely and emit evidence with zero writes.

nodes.name: Update Approved Review Fields Only
nodes.notes: Updates only the controlled review/status columns on the one identity-verified row, matching on n8n's virtual row_number after identity verification. reviewer_status is always UNREVIEWED; no create-approved value exists in this workflow. Operator must bind the same document and tab as the read node in n8n UI. Cell format RAW so values are written as plain text.

nodes.name: Emit Aggregate Evidence Only
nodes.notes: Emits the fixed aggregate-only Gate 5A evidence contract: statuses, counts, and hard-coded false write/activation flags. No IDs, hashes, row numbers, member values, timestamps, or source values.

parameters.content:
### Gate 5A Boundary
Manual inactive single-result review mapping only. Do not activate. Do not add webhook, scheduler, wait, execute-command, HTTP, SSH, SQL, AC2, bridge, tunnel, member create/update/delete, or AutoCount write nodes. The AutoCount host receives no inbound connection: the operator copies the one sanitized recovery result file into /home/node/.n8n-files/ manually. Original Gate 4 and recovery artifacts stay byte-for-byte unchanged. READY_FOR_CREATE_REVIEW stays review-only and reviewer_status stays UNREVIEWED; no state authorizes member creation.
